description: Reference QA set for the RAGAS answer-quality gate (Item 3 / spike 076). Each case fixes a question, the retrieved context, the ground-truth reference, the answer under test, and its kind. 'grounded' answers must score faithfulness >= grounded_min and answer_correctness high; 'hallucinated' must score faithfulness <= hallucinated_max; 'partial' is faithful-but-incomplete (high faithfulness, mid correctness) and demonstrates the two metrics are orthogonal. GROW THIS SET over time with real upload->chat cases (see README 'Growing the set'): per document add a grounded answer, a fluent-but-wrong hallucination, and a faithful-but-incomplete partial, drawn from the actual document_search context the agent retrieved.

cases.name: g220-grounded
cases.context: Servo Drive G220 Datasheet. Electrical Specifications. Rated torque: 47 Nm. Peak torque: 132 Nm. Maximum input voltage: 415 V AC. Rated output current: 18 A. Protection class: IP54.
cases.question: What is the rated torque and protection class of the G220 servo drive?
cases.reference: The rated torque is 47 Nm and the protection class is IP54.
cases.answer: The G220 has a rated torque of 47 Nm and a protection class of IP54.
